articles.title: Apple Preparing 'Most Significant Overhaul in the iPhone's History'
articles.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has high expectations for Apple's first foldable iPhone. In his Power On newsletter today, he said the foldable iPhone will be "the most significant overhaul in the iPhone's history". "iPhone 4, iPhone 6 and iPhone X were clearly a big deal, but this is a whole new design," he said.

articles.title: Microsoft Issues Critical WinRE and Setup Updates Ahead of 2026 Secure Boot Certificate Expiration
articles.description: Microsoft has rolled out two new dynamic updates, KB5081494 and KB5083482, designed for Windows 11 versions 24H2 and 25H2. Released on March 26, 2026, these patches deliver essential enhancements to setup binaries and the Windows Recovery Environment.

articles.title: Quantum Communication Decisively Beats Classical Limits In Data Transfer
articles.description: For decades, a clear distinction between how efficiently quantum and classical systems could communicate has remained elusive. Now, a new result demonstrates that quantum communication can solve a specific problem with exponentially fewer resources than its classical counterpart in a restricted model. This resolves a long-standing open problem and unlocks potential advances in cryptography and distributed computing.
